name: Kernel Nautico

home.title: Kernel Nautico
home.subtitle: Intelligent interaction throughout the project lifecycle.
home.intro: Kernel Nautico can combine with MAIOS Project Kernel (MPK) for project startup, context and continuity. The shipyard supplies its people, documents and systems; each project and vessel retains its own configuration and history.
home.method: Design, construction, suppliers, crew and service work on the same vessel. Kernel Nautico connects knowledge, tools and the reasons behind decisions, and forms competences that evolve through experience.
home.use: This optional visual workspace lets operator and system participate at the same time: you guide and act; the system shows changes, requirements and proposals. A relevant notification can bring useful tools into view.
home.scope: The demo uses an illustrative case: an owner’s requirement for stern access. The cards show how to explore alternatives, connect work and carry an observation forward.

presentationTitle: A requirement continues through the project and the vessel’s life.
presentationMeaning: The operator uses the workspace to follow revisions, contribute and guide work on the vessel. The system uses it to show requirements, changes, relationships and proposals. Both can take part at the same time in the same work context; project sources and action authority stay with the shipyard.
exploreMeaning: The case connects the owner’s requirements to the work of engineering, the shipyard, suppliers and service. Changing context preserves the subject and its reasons.

phases.title: Requirement
phases.text: An owner’s requirement expresses a desired use. The kernel connects the request to the product and relevant sources.

phases.title: Design
phases.text: Engineering explores alternatives, clearances and interfaces, retaining the reasons behind proposals and what needs verification.

phases.title: Construction
phases.text: The shipyard and suppliers connect configuration, work, components and observations about the same subject.

phases.title: Use and service
phases.text: The actual configuration, crew and service help explain what happens throughout the vessel’s life.

phases.title: Learning
phases.text: An observation returns to the relevant competence: the vessel, shipyard, marine domain or general method can learn different consequences.

defaults.object: Stern access on the vessel in the case
defaults.method: Sources, subject, proposal and consequence retain their relationships. The kernel composes relevant knowledge and returns observations to the competence that must operate differently.
defaults.contributionTitle: An observation becomes part of the work.
defaults.checkMeaning: The case reveals criteria and open points. Demo notes support exploration; actual assessments belong to the shipyard.
defaults.organizeTitle: Connect the next step to people and sources.
defaults.communicateTitle: Make the point of work transferable.
defaults.communicationMeaning: Subject, configuration, observation and question let engineering, the shipyard or service continue from the relevant point.
defaults.reentryMeaning: The shipyard, project and each vessel retain their own histories. This session retains local contributions and makes the next step of the case reachable.
defaults.experimentTitle: Explore the consequence of an alternative.
defaults.experimentMeaning: The projection connects a possibility to use and to the checks that would make the choice practicable.
defaults.monitorMeaning: Sources, work and observations can make a new check relevant. The demo shows that relationship through illustrative events.
defaults.monitorHorizon: When adopted, the workspace can include shipyard systems, instrumentation, maintenance, navigation and robotics, through sources and actions actually connected.
defaults.compareTitle: Compare two contributions about the case.
compareTexts: Stern access: clearances and boarding interface
Stern access: configuration, fixings and conditions of use
defaults.aiMeaning: The guide uses the kernel’s public sources and the card context to explain the method and how to continue the case.
defaults.aiPrompt: How can Kernel Nautico operate at this point in the work?

interaction.operator: Understand the work, guide the AI, act and correct.
interaction.system: Make information, changes and proposals understandable through text, images, motion and tools.
interaction.timing: Both can take part at the same time while retaining the same work context.

horizon.title: A possible extension during vessel inspection
horizon.body: Glasses displaying interactive visual content in real time could bring project drawings, dimensions and revision differences alongside the vessel element being inspected. The representation could change as the operator points, asks or moves. This is a development possibility, using the shipyard’s sources and the receiving environment’s capabilities.
horizon.current_demo: The current demo follows an illustrative stern-access case through cards, tools and dialogue.

adoption.mpk_role: Generic project startup, context, sources and continuity, composed during adoption. Kernel Nautico owns the marine knowledge and method.
adoption.other_means: AI conversation and tools already available in the adopting environment.
adoption.ui_role: K-UX-AI adds visual guidance and workspace interaction when useful.
